name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition
description: The official Minecraft Bedrock dedicated server (for phones, consoles and Windows 10/11 clients), downloaded from Mojang.

install.content:
server-name={{MOTD}}
gamemode=survival
difficulty=easy
allow-cheats=false
max-players={{MAX_PLAYERS}}
online-mode=true
server-port={{SERVER_PORT}}
server-portv6=19133
view-distance=32
player-idle-timeout=30
level-name=Bedrock level

variables.label: Server download URL
variables.description: Version-pinned zip URL from minecraft.net/download/server/bedrock. Use the bin-linux zip on Linux hosts and the bin-win zip on Windows hosts, then re-run install to update.

variables.label: LD_LIBRARY_PATH (Linux)
variables.description: Exported to the server process so the bundled libraries are found. Leave as-is.

notes: Mojang's download URL is version-pinned — grab the current URL from the official download page when you want to update (the CDN can reject requests without a browser-like User-Agent; if the download fails, fetch the zip manually and extract it via the file manager). Worlds live in worlds/, permissions in allowlist.json and permissions.json. Windows hosts: the same start command works (resolves to bedrock_server.exe).
